actions.archiveConfirmDescription: This logs out every user at this company immediately and blocks them from logging back in until reactivated.
actions.reactivateConfirmDescription: Its users will be able to log in again.

editUser.title: Edit user
editUser.companyMoveWarning: Moving {{email}} to a different company does not move anything they created — their history stays with their current company.
editUser.superAdminNoCompany: A super admin doesn't belong to any company.

resetPassword.title: Reset password for {{email}}
resetPassword.description: Sets a new password directly and ends their current session.

deleteUser.title: Permanently delete {{email}}?
deleteUser.description: Removes the user entirely. Anything they created inside their company's tenant schema keeps their user ID with no matching user — deactivating is usually the better choice.

deactivateUser.title: Deactivate {{email}}?
deactivateUser.description: This logs them out immediately and blocks login until reactivated.

reactivateUser.title: Reactivate {{email}}?
reactivateUser.description: They will be able to log in again.

endSessionUser.title: End {{email}}'s session?
endSessionUser.description: Logs them out immediately. They can log back in right away.
